decisions.reason: This position covers trench excavation and backfilling in existing gravel. Temporary shoring is included as a means of carrying out the work, not as a new purchase.
Clay, loam and sand describe the ground to be excavated, not materials to be supplied.
The surcharge covers excavating, stockpiling, replacing and compacting the existing reservoir cover material.
The existing concrete block slope protection is dismantled, stored and rebuilt using the same blocks.
The existing welded mesh fence is removed and reinstalled; no new fence is supplied.
The position covers excavation, backfilling and reinstatement of the original surface and turf without specifying new material.
This is a surcharge for manual trench excavation, not a material purchase.
The trial trenches are excavated and backfilled with the same spoil.
Previously excavated and stockpiled gravel is reused; no new aggregate is supplied.
This earthworks surcharge covers soil exchange with prescreening but does not specify supplying new fill.
The position requires a new layer of clean, non-aggressive sand beneath the pipe.

items.material_name: Clean non-aggressive pipe bedding sand, minimum 10 cm below pipe invert
items.description: Full-width trench bedding sand for rocky, stony or peaty ground.

decisions.reason: The position explicitly includes supplying sand for the pipe surround and cover.

items.material_name: Clean non-aggressive pipe surround sand, 10 cm above pipe crown
items.description: Sand placed around the pipe across the full trench width.

decisions.reason: The position expressly orders delivery of the binder. The 3% figure is a dosage per tonne of excavated soil, not the ordered binder quantity.

items.description: Blended binder for excavated soil treatment, dosed at 3% per tonne of excavated soil.

decisions.reason: The position covers distributing and mixing binder into stockpiled soil, not supplying the binder.
The position covers placing, grading and compacting already treated soil.
The position expressly requires supply of clay or highly cohesive material for trench seepage barriers.

items.material_name: 30 cm thick clay or highly cohesive soil trench cutoff plug
items.description: Prevents longitudinal seepage; keyed 10–15 cm into the trench base and walls, extending 40 cm above the pipe crown.

decisions.reason: The position covers demolition, sorting and disposal of existing concrete only.
The position calls for new C12/15 concrete to form restraints for pipe bends and fittings.

items.material_name: C12/15 rammed concrete for pipe thrust blocks
items.description: Concrete for restraining bends, branch fittings, and N and EN fittings without axial restraint.

decisions.reason: The position covers loading, hauling and unloading stockpiled material at a temporary storage area for sampling.
The position covers transport and disposal of excavated soil at a landfill, including the disposal fee.
This is a DK0 disposal variant, with no new product specified.
